_comment: Fixed platform contract, identical in every project — see ARCHITECTURE.md 'Przestrzenie nazw sygnałów'. Deliberately does NOT yet include EPM recorder, protection (zabezpieczenia), or telemechanics signals — those wait on that part of the platform contract being frozen. A new signal is a MINOR catalog_version bump; removing or renaming one is MAJOR (a project compiled against an older catalog_version than a signal's introduction should be handled by EPW-OS's own compatibility check, not this file). feat/sswin-signals (1.1.0): exposes the FIXED part of EPW-OS's alarm/intrusion subsystem (dozór, sabotaż) — state, alarms, sirens, and the commands logic may issue back to it. The dynamic part (per-line signals, SSWIN.L<n>.*) is deliberately NOT here: their count comes from the object's own EPW-OS configuration, not from hardware Logic Studio knows about, and needs a catalog-import mechanism analogous to the ELA/ADA device list import — a separate PR. Do not hand-add SSWIN.L<n>.* entries here. Prefix SSWIN. (not ALM., which is reserved for compiler-side alarm.definition conditions the logic itself computes and an operator acknowledges) is deliberate: ALM. and SSWIN. name two different kinds of thing — a logic-computed condition vs. a device subsystem's own state — and a name close to ALM./ALARM. in the signal picker's tree would invite exactly the kind of mix-up a fixed platform catalog exists to prevent. Should the alarm system later gain zone support, the SSWIN.STATE signals below keep their current, aggregate meaning (ARMED = any zone armed) and per-zone state would arrive as its own dimension, SSWIN.Z<n>.*, not by changing what these mean.

categories.name: Komunikacja
categories._comment: Per-device diagnostics (<dev>.ONLINE/<dev>.FAULT/<dev>.SAFE_PATH_OK) are NOT listed here — feat/multi-device-followups generates them programmatically in core/system_signals.py::_device_signals(), from the project's own ela_devices/ada_devices list, so every ELA/ADA device a project defines gets its diagnostics, not just a hardcoded ELA01/ADA01. See ARCHITECTURE.md §9.2/§20.

categories._comment: SSWIN.TAMPER działa niezależnie od stanu dozoru — sygnalizuje sabotaż również przy wyłączonym dozorze (obudowa/przewód/zwarcie linii to zdarzenie techniczne, nie intruzyjne, więc nie czeka na uzbrojenie obiektu).

categories._comment: Wyłącznie do odczytu stanu — wysterowaniem syreny/lampy (czas trwania, wygaszenie) zajmuje się EPW-OS wg własnej konfiguracji; logika ma jedynie wiedzieć, czy sygnalizator jest aktywny, nie sterować nim wprost.

categories.name: Komendy
categories._comment: Pierwsza kategoria sygnałów systemowych source=="logic" — zapisywanych przez logikę (system.signal_out), nie przez urządzenie. SSWIN.CMD_SILENCE jest celowo rozdzielone od SSWIN.CMD_RESET: wyciszenie sygnalizatora nie może kasować pamięci alarmu (SSWIN.ALARM_MEMORY), bo wtedy zniknąłby ślad zdarzenia zanim ktokolwiek je obejrzał.
